event_overview.name: King's Castle Battle & Kingdom of Power (KvK)
event_overview.description: The King's Castle is the central and most important building on the server map. Winning gives the Alliance Leader the power to appoint the King (or High King in KvK) who can distribute server-wide buffs, titles, and rewards.
event_overview.win_conditions: The first Alliance to occupy the King's Castle continuously for 2.5 hours wins. If no alliance achieves this after the 5 to 6-hour event timer, the Alliance with the longest total accumulated occupation time wins.

map_mechanics.alert_zone: Also known as the Red Zone. 2 hours before the King's Castle Protection Shield expires, a rebellion/storm occurs. Any player cities located inside this zone are randomly teleported away. Players must teleport back in using Advanced Teleports once the rebellion stops.
map_mechanics.relic_zone: The muddy terrain immediately surrounding the Castle. Troops marching through this area have their marching speed significantly reduced.
map_mechanics.turrets: There are 4 Turrets surrounding the King's Castle. They automatically fire upon and deal heavy continuous damage to the alliance occupying the Castle. If an alliance occupies BOTH the Castle and a Turret, that specific Turret will cease firing on them. Controlling Turrets is crucial for holding the Castle safely. In KvK, holding turrets also provides Lethality bonuses (+8% for 1, up to +20% for 4).

troop_mechanics.infantry: Tanks. High HP and Defense. Forms the frontline to absorb damage. Skills include Master Brawler (+10% damage to Cavalry) and Bands of Steel (+10% defense vs Cavalry).
troop_mechanics.cavalry: Flankers. Midline troops. Skills include Charge (+10% damage to Archers) and Ambusher (20% chance to bypass Infantry and attack Archers directly).
troop_mechanics.archers: DPS / Glass Cannons. Backline troops with high damage but low health. Skills include Ranged Strike (+10% damage to Infantry) and Volley (10% chance to attack twice).

attack_formation.purpose: Used for rallying the Castle or Turrets. Provides a strong frontline to absorb the defender's garrison while maintaining high Archer DPS to break their tanks.

defense_formation.ratio: 60% Infantry / 20% Cavalry / 20% Archers (Alternative: 70% Infantry / 30% Cavalry / 0% Archers)
defense_formation.purpose: Used for garrisoning and holding the Castle. Maximizes Infantry HP to soak damage. Archers are a liability on defense because enemy Cavalry can bypass the frontline and instantly kill them.

hero_selection.rally_leaders: The strongest player (Whale) MUST lead. All three of their heroes, stats, Truegold tech, and gear apply to the entire rally or garrison. Attack leaders should use Lethality/Attack-boosting heroes (Chenko, Amadeus, Yeonwoo). Defense leaders should use Health/Defense-boosting heroes (Gordon, Saul, Hilde, Howard).
hero_selection.rally_joiners: For players joining a rally, ONLY the first hero's top-right expedition skill matters. Gear and stats do not apply. Joiners should prioritize heroes that boost Lethality for attacks, and Health/Defense for garrisons.

advanced_tactics.batch_healing: Troops only permanently die if the Infirmary reaches 100% capacity. NEVER click 'Heal All' with speedups. Instead, select a batch of troops that takes exactly 30-45 minutes to heal. Click 'Heal', then immediately mash the Alliance 'Help' button. Active alliance members will instantly finish the heal for free. Repeat endlessly.
advanced_tactics.double_rally_waves: Strategy to unseat a mega-whale. Wave 1 (Meat Shield): A full attack rally to injure the enemy's garrison. Wave 2 (Kill Shot): Timed to hit 1-2 seconds after Wave 1, led by your biggest whale to wipe the weakened garrison. Wave 3 (Instant Garrison): Hits 1-2 seconds after Wave 2, filled entirely with defense heroes and troops to secure the Castle.
advanced_tactics.garrison_reinforcement: When a garrison takes damage, players must continuously send replacement troops to keep it full. Send replacement troops WITHOUT heroes so you do not accidentally overwrite the optimal defensive hero skills already set by the Captains.

kingdom_of_power_kvk.phase_1_matchmaking: Lasts 2 days. Matches kingdoms based on the total power of the top 100 players and server generation.
kingdom_of_power_kvk.phase_2_preparation: Lasts 5 days. Players earn points by completing daily tasks (City Construction, Hero Development, Pet Training, Troop Training, Power Boosts). The kingdom with the most points wins the right to invade the enemy server.
kingdom_of_power_kvk.phase_3_battle: Lasts 6 hours. PvP Castle Battle on the losing kingdom's server. The winner's King's Castle is shielded and safe. Whales often teleport to the enemy server 20 minutes early to attack cities and fill enemy infirmaries before the Castle opens.
kingdom_of_power_kvk.phase_4_field_triage: Lasts 2 days. Players can recover up to 90% of their permanently dead troops using Medical Satchels.
